heading: For Families
body: With an inviting 16-metre swimming pool stretching towards a manicured garden and the black sand beach beyond, The Ylang Ylang is a great holiday home for the entire family. Warm villa staff help keep an eye on the kids while you enjoy handcrafted cocktails on the pool deck. Professional babysitters are available for a small fee. Enjoy massages in the garden balé while children are mesmerised by the volcanic black sand; on tired evenings, choose from hundreds of DVDs in the air-conditioned Theatre Room. Villa holidays give families private facilities — pool, living space and gardens — not shared with other guests, and a safe environment for children to play. Kids' essentials (baby cot, inflatable pool toys, high-chair and more) can be sourced; discuss requirements at booking and they'll be ready on arrival.
